result.one_liner: Web scraping service with AI-powered data extraction from any public domain

evidence.quote: Every request the skill makes carries these headers: x-api-token: <MRSCRAPER_API_TOKEN>
MrScraper's Scraper Free includes 1,000 tokens every month at no cost - no credit card required
